prompt: Pink bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Big Birthday Cake
irony: Pink says yes to every extra until the cake grows too big to cut, so giving slices away is the sweetest bite.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green and Navy watch Pink stir a huge cake bowl in the big bright kitchen.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants a dino slice and Pink says yes to every candy, cherry and star.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac sniffs the mix, cites a baking rule, and Pink says yes again as the bowl overflows.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends chant birthday cake and Pink stacks three wobbly layers high.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green measures flour by dinosaur facts, the sponge flops, and Pink piles on sweet frosting.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The cake towers to the lamp, tips sideways, and Navy juggles cherries through sweet clouds of sugar.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends chant birthday cake again as the tower shakes above the table.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pink hugs the bowl and admits she says yes because no feels unkind.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pink puts down the icing, asks for help to share, and Green offers both hands.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Outside on the street Pink hands out slices and sings sharing is the sweetest slice.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They share birthday cake outside while Pink stirs a small sweet bowl in the big bright kitchen.
